user.title: Create a manual meter
user.description: Create one entity for this utility meter.

menu_options.add_reading: Add or correct a meter reading

add_reading.title: Add or correct a meter reading
add_reading.description: Enter the absolute reading and the exact date and time. An existing reading with the same timestamp is corrected. New readings may be inserted between existing readings; the interpolation is then recalculated.

delete_reading.title: Delete a meter reading
delete_reading.description: Select the reading to delete. Interpolated statistics are rebuilt from the remaining readings.
